title: Command Palette Dock: Center-pinned items don't render on launch until Edit Dock is opened

status.label: Duplicate or handled

next_action.label: Close as handled by Dock visibility fix

judgment.rationale: The report describes Center items hidden on launch and immediately restored by entering and exiting Edit Dock. Issue #50723 documents the same missed Center-visibility reevaluation, and merged PR #50755 calls UpdateCenterVisibility after DockControl subscribes on load. This is strong same-cause ownership evidence; do not start competing fix work. The reported 0.101.2632 build should only be treated as covered if it includes the merge.
evidence: The complete issue body reports PowerToys 0.101.2632, pinned Center items missing after each fresh launch, Start and End items unaffected, and Edit Dock restoring the Center items without changes.
Issue #50723 reports the Center region collapsed when bands resolve before DockControl loads and the same Edit Dock workaround: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/50723.
PR #50755 merged on 2026-09-24 and re-evaluates center visibility after load/subscription: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/pull/50755.
The live issue has no comments, no assignees, and only Issue-Bug and Needs-Triage labels.
judgment.recommended_action: Close as a duplicate/handled report under #50723 and PR #50755; request a build-specific regression report only if it reproduces on a build containing the merged fix.

fix_assessment.rationale: Merged PR #50755 addresses the same Center-region visibility reevaluation missed around DockControl loading; issue #50723 is the original tracking report.

issue_context.summary: Pinned Dock items in the Center region are absent after launch while Start and End remain visible; toggling Edit Dock makes Center items appear until the next launch.
known_information: The report identifies PowerToys 0.101.2632, Windows 11 26H1 build 10.0.28000.3086, and a top-positioned Dock.
The reporter supplies repeatable launch steps and an attached screenshot; no bug-report ZIP or issue comments are present.
The Center region alone is reported missing, and entering then exiting Edit Dock restores its items.
Issue #50723 covers the corresponding center-visibility-on-load race; PR #50755 merged a visibility reevaluation after load.
inferences: The missing Center surface is likely the same DockControl visibility state addressed by #50755, rather than a separate failure to load the pinned commands.
Whether the reporter's installed 0.101.2632 build contains the merged fix is not established by the issue body.
issue_context.analysis: The precise workaround and Center-only symptom align with the prior ownership trail. The existing merged fix is the relevant maintainer path; the remaining uncertainty is release/build inclusion, not a competing implementation hypothesis.
initial_investigation: Re-read the full live issue body, comments, labels, assignees, update time, and linked-work timeline immediately before judgment.
Compared the symptoms with the full #50723 report and verified PR #50755 is merged at commit c512e0632d537fe5a6e7f3400139e17cb5772327.
Confirmed the PR's stated change invokes UpdateCenterVisibility after subscribing to CenterItems changes; no fork issue or PR trace exists for #50791.

actions.label: Close as handled by Dock visibility fix

comment.body: This Center-only launch symptom and the Edit Dock workaround match the DockControl visibility issue tracked in #50723. PR #50755 merged a fix that re-evaluates Center visibility after DockControl loads. I suggest closing this report as a duplicate/handled by that work rather than starting a second fix. If the issue still reproduces on a build that includes the #50755 merge, please reopen with that exact PowerToys build and the result.
